description: This file defines an abstract class 'CombinedDisplayField' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. It appears to be part of a reporting module, providing a base for combined display fields with methods to retrieve related DTO class names, entity aliases, and fields, as well as generating SQL select parts. The class is meant to be extended by concrete implementations.

classes.name: CombinedDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract base class for combined display fields in reporting, providing methods to generate select parts and requiring subclasses to specify DTO classes, entity aliases, and fields.
